title: The Lost Current
author: Marguerite Ravensworth
blurb: Ines Vasquez, a storm chaser who owes money to dangerous optimists, has spent twenty years measuring life in miles rather than years. Then a dying prospector trades a map for a promise — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must cross the range ahead of the snows before the monsoon makes landfall.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
